title: unrecommended channels.yaml
description: The list of YouTube channels an unrecommended site shows, and the site's settings. scripts/update_videos.py reads it (and ignores unknown settings, which this schema rejects); run it with --check to verify a file.

title.description: Name at the top of the site. Default: unrecommended.

about.description: Longer text for the About page, like a YouTube channel description. Blank lines separate paragraphs; single line breaks are spaces; http(s) addresses become links (plain text when kid_safe).

logo.description: Picture next to the title: a file name in the site/ folder (svg, png, jpg, jpeg, gif, webp, ico), an https:// URL, or none. Default: logo.svg.

favicon.description: Browser tab and phone home-screen icon; same forms as logo. Default: favicon.svg.

accent.description: Highlight colour as #rrggbb, or empty for the default brick red.

kid_safe.description: For children: always TV mode (player covered, own controls), no links out of the site.

videos_per_channel.description: How many of each channel's newest regular videos to list. Default: 200.

groups.description: Group name -> list of channels. Groups appear as tabs, in this order. A channel may appear in several groups.

oneOf.description: A channel: @handle, https://www.youtube.com/@handle, .../channel/UC..., .../c/name, .../user/name, or a bare UC... ID. Not a video link.

url.description: The channel, in any form accepted above.

name.description: Name to show instead of the channel's own.

include.description: Other unrecommended repositories whose channels are added (one level deep). Add #GroupName to take one group only.
